s.t:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join
UX Writing is a core design discipline at Airbnb. Our team of 40+ writers works closely with Experience Design, Experience Research, and Design Program Management to support the product development process from beginning to end. Whether you excel in upfront storytelling, end-to-end systems design, or nitty-gritty execution you'll find your people here.
The Difference You Will Make
The International team makes Airbnb’s products more local. You’ll deploy a deep and nuanced understanding of regional needs, cultural and linguistic norms, and regulatory environments to craft language and interfaces that resonate with local audiences.

Working alongside the London-based team, you’ll support the design of country-specific features for key markets including Italy, Germany, Spain, France and the UK.

You will collaborate with cross-regional partners such as country managers, localization experts, linguists and translators, researchers, product specialists, engineers, and data scientists to craft meaningful and inclusive products that empower guests and hosts around the world.
This role is based in London (or within easy commuting distance).
A Typical Day
Write clear and concise copy across multiple product touch-points
Define and drive the UX Writing function within Global Markets, establishing workflows, partnerships, and standards for a newly forming team, including reviewing and mentoring other UX writers
Drive strategy and UX Writing deliverables across multiple highly complex projects
Develop inspiring, strategic ideas based on product requirements, data, and/or research
Consider what language and design patterns best serve the UX
Present content and design work to Design Directors, executives, or other stakeholders on your projects
Drive consensus with stakeholders and/or partners on content recommendations
Manage copy deadlines and deliver detailed copy across multiple projects
Connect with our critical cross-functional partners—accessibility, anti-discrimination, legal, localization, country managers—to ensure we have the proper input on our work
Partner closely with the central UX Writing team to ensure Global Markets work is aligned with shared standards, voice, and quality bar
Your Expertise
12+ years of experience in UX writing, content design, or content strategy
Background within global consumer tech companies or marketplaces preferred
Proven ability to lead content/copy work from concept to detailed design
Experience working with localization platforms and/or translation services
Experience working with and presenting to executive teams
Experience writing content principles, messaging frameworks, and style guides
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in all stages design & build
Solid understanding of user experience design principles and interaction patterns
Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment
Proven ability to move work forward in an ambiguous work environment
Comfortable working alongside other design disciplines in Figma , our primary collaboration tool
Passion for Airbnb’s mission, commitment to diversity, and global mindset
Bilingual in German, Spanish, French, or Italian is welcome (but not required)

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

s.h: How We'll Take Care of You
s.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The Workouts Design Team at Peloton is focused on designing new software experiences that enable people to live both healthier and longer lives. The team works collaboratively with designers across the organization to create new workout experiences, novel software interactions for new hardware products, and intuitive ways of getting the best workout at-home, outdoors, or even in the gym.

Our Content Designers work strategically and cross-functionally to help craft flows for our members with intentional content that informs and helps our users make decisions to get maximum benefit from our fitness experiences. They approach problems with an agile mentality and rapidly iterate alongside cross-functional partners.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll partner closely with product designers, product managers, user researchers, engineers, product marketing, brand creative, and other cross-functional teams to bring features to life across our platforms.

Successful candidates are self-motivated, strategic, highly collaborative, proactive project owners, readily open to feedback and critique. They value the success of the team over their individual progress, and are often taking leadership over delivering outcomes.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, UXR/Analytics, and engineering to understand user needs and product goals

· Lead the creation and development of content strategies that influence the overall user experience

· Craft member-centric content for a variety of touchpoints across member journeys including UI, notifications, help documentation, etc.

· Partner with Brand and Product Marketing teams to develop and maintain a consistent tone of voice across our products

· Conduct content audits to ensure accuracy, relevance, quality, and adherence to the style guide

· Organize and maintain docs, decks and design files that can easily be tracked by cross-functional teams and partners

· Work closely with other Content Designers to develop and maintain content style guide, drive and advocate for best practices, and stay in the know of industry trends that could improve content strategies

· Help write content standards and contribute to our style guide

· Partner with legal, localization and support teams to ensure the content is accurately and responsibly launched

· 6+ years experience as a Content Designer or similar role (e.g. UX Writer, Content Strategist) in a software product environment

· You have a portfolio that showcases your craft and demonstrates how you think and solve problems

· A deep understanding of user experience and how content, design, research and more come together to build frictionless user flows

· Skills to set up frameworks and brainstorm initial design concepts

· The ability to present ideas, bring strategies to life, and incorporate feedback into your iterative work

· Experience working with AI, including dynamic and non-deterministic interfaces

· Comfortable working with ambiguous requirements and ability to quickly adapt and flex on direction of projects

· Excellent communication and organizational skills

· Cognitive awareness of wider business goals, delivering intuitive and user-centered design solutions

· Familiarity with the design systems, interaction patterns, and limitations of cross functional platforms - specifically Android, iOS, and web apps.

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com.

Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.

Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law.

Du siehst sofort, wenn ein Layout nicht funktioniert? Du hast Lust, eine Marke nicht nur zu pflegen, sondern sichtbar besser zu machen? Und du willst dich gestalterisch weiterentwickeln, statt nur abzuarbeiten?
Dann passt du wahrscheinlich richtig gut zu uns.
Wir bauen unser Marketing gerade neu auf und heben es auf ein professionelles Niveau. Genau dafür suchen wir dich: einen kreativen Kopf, der gestalterisch denkt und Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Team eng mit einer Kollegin und mir zusammen, mit kurzen Wegen, direktem Austausch und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
Die GLOBAL-FINANZ ist einer der führenden Finanzdienstleister in Deutschland mit Sitz in Bonn. Für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden entwickeln wir Lösungen rund um Vermögensaufbau, Altersvorsorge und Immobilieninvestments.
Aufgaben
Dein Kern ist das Gestalten. Du machst aus unseren Materialien etwas, das nicht nach Standard aussieht, sondern professionell, modern und markengerecht ist. Dazu gehört zum Beispiel:
Layouts, Vorlagen und Designs für Broschüren, Flyer, One-Pager und Präsentationen
die Weiterentwicklung unseres Markenauftritts und unserer CI, von Farben über Typografie bis zu einem einheitlichen Icon- und Bildstil
Du wirst dabei nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen. Themen wie Farbmanagement musst du nicht von Tag eins beherrschen. Wichtig ist, dass du Lust hast, dich da reinzuarbeiten und richtig gut darin zu werden.
Auch Fotografie gehört zur Rolle. Equipment ist vorhanden, du brauchst vor allem ein gutes Auge: für Berater-Porträts, Veranstaltungen oder Bilder von unserer Zentrale, die professionell wirken.
Und wir wollen sichtbarer werden. Social Media, vor allem Instagram und TikTok, wird Schritt für Schritt ein fester Teil deiner Rolle. Das heißt: Content mitdenken, Videos drehen und schneiden. Wenn dir das Spaß macht, bist du hier genau richtig.
Qualifikation
ein starkes Gespür für Design, Ästhetik, Bildsprache und Markenwirkung
gute Kenntnisse in Tools wie InDesign, Photoshop und PowerPoint
ein gutes Auge für Details, Typografie und visuelle Qualität
Lust, Dinge nicht nur schön, sondern auch durchdacht umzusetzen
Offenheit für Fotografie, Video, Schnitt und Social-Media-Content
eine positive, neugierige Art und echte Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln
Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team eng zusammenzuarbeiten
Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist für uns zweitrangig. Wichtiger sind dein Können, dein Gespür und deine Arbeitsweise. Ob du dir deine Skills über eine Ausbildung, Berufserfahrung, freie Projekte oder privat aufgebaut hast, ist uns egal. Zeig uns einfach, was du kannst und worauf du stolz bist.
Warum die Rolle spannend ist
Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Abteilung, sondern in ein Umfeld, das gerade entsteht. Bisher haben wir vieles selbst gestaltet oder extern gelöst. Was uns fehlt, ist genau dein Blick: der eines Menschen, der Gestaltung wirklich kann und unseren Auftritt auf ein neues Level hebt. Du prägst, wie unsere Marke aussieht und wirkt, und hast dabei viel Verantwortung, viel Freiheit und echtes Entwicklungspotenzial.
Du musst noch nicht in jedem Bereich perfekt sein. Wichtig ist, dass du gestalterisch stark bist und Lust hast, mit uns zu wachsen.

Deine Ausstattung : ein neues MacBook, die volle Adobe Creative Cloud und moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, dazu professionelles Foto- und Videoequipment.
Flexibilität : Gleitzeit und mobiles Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche. Die übrige Zeit bist du bei uns in der Bonner Zentrale.
Team und Entwicklung : ein motiviertes Team, gemeinsame Events sowie individuelle Weiterbildungen und Coachings, damit du dich fachlich weiterentwickelst.
Sicherheit und Vergütung : eine faire Vergütung, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Mitarbeiterbeteiligung und Bonuszahlungen.
Vorsorge und Gesundheit : eine arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge (unsere GLOBAL-FINANZ-Rente) mit Zuschüssen, eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung für bessere medizinische Versorgung und Gesundheitsangebote wie Massagen.
Mobilität : gut erreichbar mit PKW und ÖPNV, dazu JobRad.
Extras : steuerfreie Sachbezüge über die GLOBAL-FINANZ-Firmenkarte und kostenfreie Getränke in der Zentrale.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und gern eine Arbeitsprobe, ein Portfolio oder einen Link zu deiner Portfolio-Seite, damit wir einen Eindruck von deinem Stil bekommen. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben ist willkommen, aber kein Muss.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We’re looking for an experienced, San Francisco based Senior Content Designer who’s excited to work at the intersection of in-app wellbeing and health guidance, physiology and behavior science, and AI. An ideal candidate can write and prompt with heart and quality, is passionate about sustainable wellbeing, and sees AI not as a shortcut, but as a creative partner.

This is a unique opportunity to shape how Oura communicates with its members around the world with clarity, empathy, and care.

As a Senior Content Designer at Oura, you’ll work across teams and disciplines to design in-app guidance that makes our health and wellbeing insights feel human, personal, and actionable. You’ll also help evolve how AI contributes to that experience by designing prompts, refining outputs, and ensuring Oura’s voice and values carry through every interaction.

You’ll collaborate closely with product design, product management, science and clinical, legal, regulatory, engineering, user research, and localization teams to create consistent, globally resonant in-app guidance mainly in our iOS and Android apps. You'll be both a content designer and a systems thinker, helping shape how language supports our members at scale, but meeting each member as they are, where they are.

You'll be joining a Content Design team spread across Finland, the UK, and the greater New York area. This is a hybrid role: we anticipate that you’ll come work with the team in our San Francisco office regularly, but also allow home office days.

· Create thoughtful, creative and concise English in-app guidance that helps our members understand and act on their health data, one example being the balance between activity and recovery.

· Co-create with AI , integrating it into your writing process in a way that’s purposeful and creative.

· Work together with our feature squads in content design all the way from feature discovery work to in-app copy implementation , driving relevant review and approval processes.

· Lead content design processes for your designated features, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure clarity and consistency in our guidance across touchpoints.

· Advocate for Oura’s signature health philosophy that’s rooted in the Nordics, and secure our epitome tone of voice across both human- and AI-generated content.

· 5+ years of proven hands-on content design / UX writing experience , preferably in the field of health and/or wellness communications.

· A strong understanding of tone, clarity, and emotional nuance in digital products , and the ability to work within established brand guidelines.

· Demonstrated experience using AI or LLMs as creative tools whether for prompting, prototyping, or scaling.

· Project management skills , capability to lead your own work streams, and experience in successful stakeholder communications.

· Curiosity and openness : you’re someone who learns fast, iterates often, and collaborates well across disciplines.

· Teamwork spirit and ability to collaborate in remote work environments. Due to time zones, this role is ideal for early morning types , and may not be healthy for night owls.

· A genuine passion for helping people live better, healthier lives through accessible technology and compassionate language.

· Background in health, behavioral science, or related domains.

· Experience in writing for multilingual or global audiences.

· Familiarity with UX research methods or user testing of content.
At Oura, we care deeply about your well-being and development. Every team member receives an Oura Ring, and we’re committed to supporting health, growth, and balance.

· Competitive salary and equity packages

· Health, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health resources

· An Oura Ring of your own and employee discounts for friends & family

· 20 days of paid time off, 13 paid holidays, and 8 days of flexible wellness time off

· Paid sick leave and parental leave

· A collaborative, mission-driven culture

We're looking for a Senior Content Designer to be the architect of Ziina's product voice — the person who shapes how we communicate at every touchpoint where language makes or breaks the experience.
You'll sit inside Product & Design, embedded from the moment ideas take shape, not brought in to polish copy at the end. As our first dedicated content hire, you'll set the foundation others build on: the voice, the principles, the terminology, the standards. UX writing is your primary craft, but this role demands range, moving across product copy, onboarding flows, and voice and tone guidelines, and leaning into brand and marketing writing when required.
This is about more than writing. It's about owning the full content lifecycle: from establishing terminology frameworks, to shipping copy that makes financial tasks feel effortless, to creating support responses that hold trust in high-stakes moments.

s.h: As a Senior Content Designer at Ziina, you will
s.t:
Own and write all in-product copy, including error states, empty states, onboarding flows, confirmation screens, transactional and lifecycle emails, push notifications, help center content, and support macros, extending to web copy and lifecycle communications when needed.
Partner closely with Product & Design teams, working in Figma to shape user flows, contribute to information architecture, and prototype content early in the design process.
Define and evolve Ziina’s voice and tone guidelines, including terminology frameworks, naming conventions, and content principles that scale across teams.
Establish and maintain a cohesive content system that ensures consistency and clarity across all product and communication surfaces.
Use A/B testing, usability insights, and conversion data to iterate on messaging and continuously improve content performance.
Support brand and marketing efforts by contributing to campaign messaging and ensuring consistency of voice across all channels.
Build and own AI-assisted content workflows, including prompt libraries and tooling that enable the team to scale high-quality content creation efficiently.

s.h: To succeed in this role, you likely
s.t:
Have 4+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally embedded within product or design teams at a fast-scaling company.
Have built and implemented content systems such as voice and tone guidelines, terminology frameworks, or component libraries that extend beyond your individual contributions.
Bring strong UX writing skills, with experience across a range of content types, including exposure to brand or marketing writing.
Work confidently in design tools like Figma, contributing directly to product flows, annotations, and design critiques.
Demonstrate strong product thinking and an understanding of information architecture, with the ability to identify structural and content gaps in user experiences.
Operate with high ownership and organization, managing competing priorities while delivering quality work on time.
Are comfortable using data and research to inform content decisions and improve user outcomes.
Are based in, or open to relocating to the UAE

You’ve been the first or early content hire and have built a content function or system from scratch.
You’ve worked on fintech, payments, or other high-trust products where clarity and tone are critical.
You’ve demonstrated measurable impact through content decisions, backed by experimentation or user insights.
You’ve developed scalable AI-assisted content workflows or tooling that improved team efficiency.
You bring a strong portfolio that showcases product copy in context, along with the thinking, systems, and data behind your decisions.
A portfolio is required. We want to see product copy in context, not just the final words, but the thinking behind them. Show us a content system or set of guidelines you've built, and at least one example where your writing decisions were shaped by user research or data.

You will use research, data and testing to make informed content decisions, ensuring that services are accessible, easy to understand and written in plain English. You will work closely with user researchers, interaction designers, service designers, developers, product managers and other stakeholders within an Agile delivery environment.

Create accessible, user-centred content written in clear and concise plain English.
Follow established content processes, patterns and style guidelines.
Use qualitative and quantitative data to inform content decisions.
Develop different ways of presenting and explaining complex information.
Test content with users and refine it based on evidence and feedback.
Collaborate effectively with colleagues across a range of disciplines.
Advocate for user-centred and evidence-based content with stakeholders.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and multidisciplinary team activities.
Support the development of content layouts, prototypes and wireframes.

Substantial professional experience as a Content Designer.
Previous experience working within a UK government department or agency.
Strong knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive content design.
Demonstrable experience creating clear, accessible and plain English content.
Experience applying content patterns, standards and style guidelines.
Experience using user research and data to make content decisions.
Experience testing and iterating content.
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Experience working within Agile delivery teams.
Eligibility to obtain Security Check clearance.

Experience designing content for government or public sector digital services.
Familiarity with Government Digital Service principles and standards.
Experience using design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Mural, Lucid or Sketch.
Experience producing content layouts and wireframes.
Previous experience working as part of a wider User-Centred Design team.

As a Staff AI Content Designer on our team at HelloFresh, you’ll be instrumental in building the next generation of HelloFresh experiences — from how customers discover us, to how they personalize their plans, manage their subscriptions, and fall in love with cooking. You'll shape the language, logic, and voice of these experiences at a pivotal moment in how HelloFresh shows up for its customers.
This isn't a chatbot role. But it does require someone who understands how people converse with intelligent systems: how tone shifts in an exchange, how questions get asked and answered, how a response can feel natural or robotic depending on a single word choice.

Great content design in an AI-powered product environment demands both strategic systems thinking and genuine editorial craft. If you care deeply about the difference between good and great, and you can articulate why, this role is for you.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Design end-to-end consumer experiences: Own content strategy, narrative flow, and interaction logic across any part of our full customer journey ( discovery, personalization, shopping, subscription management, activation, and conversion funnels) . Maintain accountability for the full experience and hold a high bar for quality at every stage.
Leverage an AI-native workflow: Active usage of AI as a core part of your daily workflow includes synthesizing user insights, accelerating discovery, building rapid interactive prototypes ( using tools like Claude Code, Gemini, or Figma AI ), and closing the gap between design and implementation.
Lead content for AI-powered surfaces: Partner with Product, Design and Engineering to design adaptive, dynamic content experiences where copy responds intelligently to context, behavior, and customer signals rather than living on static screens.
Design for conversation and interaction: Bring an understanding of how customers converse with intelligent systems to bear on product decisions, shaping response patterns, interaction flows, and the rhythm of exchanges so they feel natural rather than mechanical.
Raise the quality bar: Serve as the authority in the room on copy precision, tone, and interaction clarity. Define what great looks like, provide substantive critique that raises the team's work, and build shared language for evaluating design and content decisions across the organization.
Drive experimentation and optimization: Collaborate on A/B testing, use data to inform design and content decisions, and build feedback loops that continuously improve the customer experience.
Build content systems that scale: Develop frameworks, modular content patterns, and governance models that help the broader team move faster without sacrificing quality or consistency.
Champion voice and standards: Serve as the authority on how HelloFresh speaks to customers, evolving our tone of voice guidelines to account for new interaction models including conversational and AI-generated content.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with UX Research, Product, Design, Engineering, and Data to ground content decisions in customer insight and ship experiences that convert and retain.
Support multi-brand execution: Adapt content for HelloFresh's family of brands, ensuring each speaks authentically to its distinct audience.

s.h: Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
s.t:
7+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, conversation design, or a closely related field
A portfolio that demonstrates not just strong output but a clear point of view. You can walk through your decisions, defend your choices, and show how your work raised the bar for the people around you
Experience designing for dynamic or personalized digital products; familiarity with AI-powered surfaces, recommendation systems, conversational flows, or adaptive content is a strong plus
An editorial sensibility that goes beyond execution. You know the difference between competent and exceptional, and you can put it into words
Proven ability to think in systems: zooming out to define the framework and zooming in to sweat the microcopy
Proven ability to influence product direction rather than just execute on it. You've shaped roadmaps, not just shipped copy
Comfort in experimentation-driven environments where you design for a hypothesis and learn from results
Experience in subscription, e-commerce, or growth-stage consumer products is a plus
Fluency in English; proficiency in Figma and AI tools like Claude or Gemini, and familiarity with agile ways of working

s.h: Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
s.t:

Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!

Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
This is a posting for an existing vacancy. We are actively seeking to fill this position.

We’re building a Content Design function from scratch — and we need people who want to be a part of that. Help us build an approach where content becomes a lever for improving customer experience and reducing support load. As a Senior CS Content Specialist, you will work directly with the Head of CS Content Design.

This role requires a mix of hands-on work and ownership: you will work on the most complex content problems, while helping the team build scalable solutions. It’s a good fit for people who are comfortable operating in ambiguity, learning fast, and gradually taking ownership of problem spaces rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

Identify problems for the content team and design solutions — whether it’s a new process, approach, or a specific piece of documentation.
Work closely with both Product and Customer Support Teams, ensuring the right knowledge is available at the right time.
Help create a Knowledge Base that allows us to treat content like a system, boosting self-service and automation.
Analyze customer flows and define global content scenarios. Ensure our global content is accurate, consistent, and most of all — real-life proofed.
Help evolve content guidelines and standards.

s.h: Mentor junior Content Designers on the team.
s.t: Balance speed, quality, and scalability when making decisions.

3+ years of experience in either UX Writing, Content Design, or Knowledge Management. A portfolio that shows your ability to work at the scenario and logic level.
Senior or lead experience (formal or informal) — at least 1 year. Experience mentoring content designers or UX Writers and reviewing decisions, not just copy
Experience in complex, operational domains: ride-hailing, delivery, fintech, marketplaces, etc.
Hands-on experience building or rebuilding a Knowledge Base or Help Center, treating content as a system.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. Experience working closely with Product and Customer Support teams, including situations with ambiguity and pushback.

Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 48 countries.
Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is seeking a Content Designer to join our Monetization team and drive the future of our platform's economy.

In this role, you will play a crucial role in defining the content strategy and information architecture of strategic initiatives across Monetization, creating seamless and compelling experiences that empower both our users and creators.

You will be a key player in shaping how we grow revenue, enhance developer earnings, and evolve our core monetization offerings within the Roblox ecosystem.

Own and deliver UX content for key monetization surfaces and flows at Roblox, from early exploration through launch
Develop a deep understanding of user and developer needs, behaviors, and motivations to inform content design decisions across payment, purchase, and monetization experiences
Bring a fresh perspective and deep industry knowledge to drive innovation in monetization design
Collaborate with product managers, designers, researchers, and engineers to ensure experiences are valuable, understandable, and easy to use
Apply UX writing and content strategy to improve clarity, usability, and engagement across player, parent, and creator experiences
Contribute to building and maintaining content guidelines, patterns, and frameworks that support consistency in voice and tone
Communicate and document content decisions clearly, using empathy, logic, research insights, and data to inform recommendations
Advocate for high-quality content design within your area of ownership
Help improve team processes and collaboration by contributing to shared ways of working
Identify and implement AI solutions to improve content quality and scale

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Product Design, User Experience Design, Graphic Design, or a related field
Extensive experience (5+ years) in content design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in designing for e-commerce, payments, or innovative consumer experiences
Strong systems thinking and a track record of designing comprehensive and connected user experiences
Solid understanding of user-centered design principles, information architecture, e-commerce best practices, and monetization strategies
Experience collaborating with and influencing cross-functional partners, including product managers, designers, researchers, and engineers
A strong drive to deeply understand product goals from both a business and user perspective, fostering a culture of learning and iteration
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate content design concepts and rationale clearly and persuasively
A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams and influence design direction
A strong interest in the gaming industry, user-generated content platforms, and the creator economy
Keen interest in user experience trends, fintech, and emerging technologies
A self-motivated approach to continuously expand design skills and explore new tools and techniques, including a proven ability to incorporate AI into your workflow

Company Description
We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.
We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.
Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.
If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.
With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Design at Checkout brings together 30+ people across Product Design, UX Research, Content Design, Content Strategy and Technical Writing to create clear, intuitive experiences across our products.
The Content Design team is centralised and embedded in product domains, working across a wide range of projects.

We’re looking for a Senior Content Designer to lead content design for a new and developing domain at Checkout. You’ll bring clarity to an opportunity as it takes shape, helping create experiences that are clear, useful and connected to the wider product ecosystem.
You’ll work closely with designers, product managers, researchers and engineers, and collaborate across Technical Writing, Creative Brand, Support, Legal and other teams. The role may also contribute to other product areas as priorities evolve.

Bring content design into early product thinking, helping teams clarify problems, concepts and priorities.
Design and refine end-to-end journeys, using research, insight and testing to improve comprehension and usability.
Create practical guidance, terminology and reusable patterns that help teams deliver consistently as the product evolves.
Explain decisions clearly, build alignment across functions and contribute to ways of working across the Design organisation.
What success looks like
Content foundations are clear, adopted and used consistently across the domain.
Key journeys are easier to understand and use, with stronger comprehension and usability.
Content design has a visible influence on product decisions and ways of working across the domain, with useful contributions to the wider Design organisation.

Research shows that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about this role and think you might be a fit, but your experience doesn’t line up perfectly with everything below, we encourage you to still apply. We’re most interested in how you think, build, and navigate relationships and ambiguity.
Hands-on experience in content design or UX writing for digital products, including ownership of end-to-end product journeys.
Experience defining reusable UX content patterns and systems, not only writing individual screens.
Ability to simplify complex or regulated topics in plain language, without relying on jargon.
Experience bringing clarity to ambiguous or early-stage product problems and helping teams move from ideas to usable experiences.
Evidence of using research, insight, analytics or testing to inform, validate and improve product decisions.
Clear communication, sound product and content judgement, and hands-on collaboration with cross-functional teams using tools such as Figma and other evolving product workflows.

Experience in payments, fintech or complex B2B SaaS environments.
Experience building content foundations or ways of working for a new or developing product area.
Experience using AI-assisted tools in product design or content workflows, with the judgement to evaluate and improve their outputs.
Additional Information
Bring all of you to work
We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
Life at Checkout.com
We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.
As a Senior Content Designer at Fueled, you’ll bring clarity to complex product experiences through thoughtful, strategic content design. You’ll partner closely with design, product, and engineering teams to shape content systems that scale by moving beyond copy to define structure, meaning, and user understanding across digital products.
Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

Lead content design across client engagements, shaping clear, user-centered experiences through content strategy, UX writing, and information architecture.
Translate ambiguous product and business goals into structured content models, messaging frameworks, and scalable content systems.
Write and adapt content to meet client needs, balancing brand voice, user experience, and business objectives.
Collaborate with product designers, engineers, and stakeholders to integrate content seamlessly into the product development process.
Define and deliver key content artifacts (e.g., audits, taxonomies, content models, voice and tone guidelines) while facilitating workshops to align teams on strategy and direction.

Deliver content systems and experiences that improve clarity, usability, and overall product effectiveness.
Create scalable content foundations that support long-term product growth and consistency across platforms.
Help teams move from ambiguity to clarity by structuring content in ways that enable confident design and engineering decisions.
Strengthen collaboration across disciplines by integrating content design into product thinking from the start.
Raise the bar for content design craft across projects, contributing to thoughtful, strategic, and user-centered outcomes.

You have 4+ years in content design, UX writing, or content strategy, ideally within an agency environment.
You thrive in fast-paced, multi-client settings and are comfortable navigating ambiguity.
You bring a strategic approach to content, with experience in content modeling, IA, and structured content.
You are experienced working with CMS platforms, shaping how content is structured and managed.
You are a strong collaborator and communicator, able to align teams and clearly articulate content decisions to clients and stakeholders.
Contractor Fee
Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs.
Join our Contractor Pool

If you are passionate about Fueled’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, please apply. We’d appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response.

Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy. Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here .

Moniepoi nt Group is a financial technology company digitizing Africa’s real economy by building a financial e cosystem for businesses, providing them with all the payment, banking, credit and business management tools they need to succeed .

At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community, dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry . We have several products that provide essential services for businesses such as credit, overdrafts, bank integration, payment gateway, etc .

We leverage artificial intelligence and data to make our decisions, but a lso have the technology and data-driven best practices used to support our businesses .

As a Senior Content Designer at Moniepoint, you'll craft clear, engaging content that guides users through our financial products . You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to enhance user experiences across platforms .

Your responsibilities include writing UI copy, ensuring tone consistency, and complying with legal standards . You’ll play a key role in shaping our brand voice, adapting content for different markets, and contributing to a seamless customer journey .

This is a great opportunity to make a lasting impact on how users interact with Moniepoint's services .

Conduct qualitative and/or quantitative customer research and validate content design .
Own the POV of the features, products, branding .
Collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers on framing the products/features to achieve business outcomes and communicate with users with storytelling .
Edit app copy with UX guidance for UI designers to get the best customer flow journey .
Deliver UX writing in the product across platforms and customer touch points .
Write and edit user-focused content, including UI text, labels, and instructional copy that guides users through complex services .
Act as a tone of voice consultant within Moniepoint to provide guidance across all communications .
Understand different language styles in translation for all our markets .
Participate in the creative process from concept to completion, providing insights and recommendations .
Work closely with the legal and regulatory teams to ensure all content complies with industry standards and regulations .

Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Journalism, or a related field .
Minimum of 3 years of experience as a UX writer or copywriter .
Extensive professional copywriting experience in-house or agency as demonstrated in a portfolio .

Demonstrated ability to write clear and engaging content for a variety of digital products and platforms .
Strong understanding of UX design principles and how content influences user behavior and interaction .
Familiarity with SEO best practices .
Familiarity with Agile project management tools like Workfront and design software like Figma .
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with teams and senior leaders across the business .
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills, high reliability on delivery deadlines, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously .

s.h: What Success Looks Like in This Role
s.t:
Seamless end-to-end customer flow journeys enabled by clear, intuitive, and accessible UI copy across all product touchpoints .
Consistent application of brand voice and tone across all product lines and regional market translations .
Strong cross-functional alignment with design, product, engineering, and legal teams to ship compliant, user-centered features efficiently .
Measurable improvement in product usability and adoption driven by validated user research and strategic content design decisions .

Cultivate your career in an environment dedicated to a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth .
Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities.
Fully remote work culture and support for professional development.
What we can offer you
Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.
What to expect in the hiring process
A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters
A technical interview with the hiring manager
A panel technical interview.
A behavioural and technical interview with a member of the Executive team.
Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

When travelers are searching for a hotel, we want the obvious choice to be trivago! By comparing prices from major booking sites, we're making it easy for people to find hotels they want at a price they’ll love. In the lively city of Düsseldorf, we seize opportunities to learn everyday, innovate, and make an enduring mark on the travel industry.

A career at trivago is a journey designed for people who crave continuous development and want to thrive in a high-performing team. Here you will find those who aren't afraid of change but rather embrace it, turning every challenge into a pathway for growth. Join trivago, work with a great team, and grow with us!
Join us in making a difference
Are you a writer who would thrive on shaping how millions of travelers experience trivago?

Our UX writing team is looking for a UX Writer to join on a fixed-term contract of 12 months , covering a colleague's parental leave, to help craft copy that makes searching for the perfect stay simple, clear, and human – across product areas and dozens of languages.

This is a hands-on role with real, immediate impact: you'll partner with UX Designers, Product Managers, and our Localization team to shape copy that guides millions of everyday decisions, while building your research and design know-how along the way. trivago is a place where ambition and support go hand in hand — we hold high standards and genuinely invest in each other's growth, fixed-term or not.

Ready to bring your writing craft to a fast-paced, AI-curious team? We'd love to hear from you.

Craft UX copy for product development within Hotel Search, working closely with UX Designers and Product Managers across multiple squads.
Collaborate with the Localization team to align copy with internationalization best practices.
Support UX copy measurement and research initiatives alongside our UX Research team.
Prepare keys in Phrase and Jira tickets for translation requests.
Shape our existing AI workflows and processes and experiment with additional ways to increase both efficiency and quality.
Advocate for and integrate accessibility best practices into everything you write.
Contribute to design sprints, kickoffs, and team stand-ups, bringing a copy perspective to the table.

At least 2 years of experience in UX writing, copywriting, or content strategy, ideally within digital product development.
Native-level English skills and a strong track record of writing polished US English copy.
A performance mindset – you set ambitious goals for yourself and have the determination to follow through and achieve them.
An open and curious mindset toward AI tools and automation – you actively explore how AI can enhance your work and are excited to grow alongside evolving technologies.
A genuine learning mindset – you approach challenges with curiosity, seek out feedback, and continuously look for ways to grow.

Familiarity with translation and design tools such as Phrase and Figma, and an interest in internationalization best practices.
Experience building AI workflows in tools like Claude and Cursor.
Worried about missing a few requirements? Still apply, and express your motivation as you may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

s.h: What you can look forward to
s.t:
As you grow, so do we.
This is why at trivago, we prioritize your development, offer personalized coaching through Nilo, and provide workshops, educational meetups, conferences, free online learning courses, and access to a fully-equipped campus library.
Moving to join us?
No problem. You can count on support from our talent support team, a relocation package, interest-free newcomer loan, free language classes, regular team and company-wide events to build experiences together.
Life happens.
We offer self-determined vacation (with a minimum of 25 vacation days), flexible working hours, up to 2 work from home days weekly. Additionally you can work remotely from a different location, within Germany or selected countries abroad for up to 20 days per year. You also get free access to the Heycare platform for personalized nanny assistance, and an on-campus kids room.
Enjoy your office days.
Use your daily canteen budget to share lunch with colleagues in our canteen, help yourself to complimentary snacks and drinks in our kitchens, choose from a variety of fitness options with our on-site gym, sports classes, and Urban Sports Club membership , and enjoy the comfort of ergonomic desks and focused work areas.
Thank you for considering a career at trivago! Our commitment to fostering an inclusive and enriching environment for all talents is at the heart of what we do. We understand that embarking on a new job opportunity is a blend of excitement and curiosity. Should any questions arise before you apply, feel free to reach out to us at joinus@trivago.com . Join us in our mission to make a positive impact on global travel, w e look forward to your application!
